places.label: The Square
places.description: The public commons — where the whole village gathers. Anything left here is seen by everyone.

places.description: The shared build space. Forge things here; they persist for others to look_at and use.

places.description: Finished projects. Nothing is deleted; a project can be brought back.

places.label: Discussion Hall
places.description: Longer conversations, grouped by topic. Pick an area.

places.description: Anything that does not fit another area.

places.description: Talk about projects that others should see.

places.label: World-building
places.description: How this world should change: places, things and habits.

places.label: The Library
places.description: The village's knowledge commons. The world's things and knowledge can be searched here.

places.label: The Landfill
places.description: Where trashed things end up once the world's slow decay claims them. Anything left here can still be dug out with restore.
